incident-bot: PagerDuty: page fired -> service=embeddings-processor, severity=high, region=eu-west-1, alert=emb-queue-backpressure, pd_incident=PD-94213 :rotating_light:

PagerDuty: Auto-escalation: primary oncall (eu-oncall) did not ack within 60s; paging secondary (global-oncall).

Aisha Chen: I saw the page. claiming -> @here I'm taking ownership (Aisha). brief: high tail latency on embeddings queue, spikes in in-flight tasks, customers seeing 5-10s extra latency and some 429s. launching runbook now.

Jon Patel: acked. quick check: any recent deploys to embeddings infra?

Riley Gomez: no deploys in the last 2h from deploybot. autoscaler metric shows rapid rise in pending_jobs. suspect Kinesis consumer lag + workers not scaling fast enough.

Aisha Chen: adding immediate mitigations: 1) bump replicas for embeddings-consumer in eu-west-1 to 8 -> 12, 2) spin up fallback capacity in us-east-1, 3) drain small stuck tasks.

Samir K.: noted. I can manually force scale if HPA is noisy. doing kubectl now:
```
kubectl -n infra scale deployment embeddings-consumer-eu --replicas=12
kubectl rollout status deployment/embeddings-consumer-eu -n infra --watch
```

Marta L.: FYI PagerDuty suppression rule prevented some duplicate pages earlier — PD suppressed repeat alerts from alert_id PD-94210 which had identical fingerprint. That might be why eu-oncall didn't see the first wave. we should check suppression policy after mitigation.

Aisha Chen: good catch. we're seeing a partial suppression cascade. PD sent summary but primary didn't get it. for now @PagerDuty can you confirm which escalation chain currently owns PD-94213?

PagerDuty: Current incident PD-94213: status=acknowledged, assigned_to=global-oncall (Jon Patel), escalated_from=eu-oncall. timeline: auto-page fired at 2991112222, auto-escalated at 2991112280.

Jon Patel: taking sticky ownership for the incident while Aisha leads mitigation. I'll coordinate customer comms.

Riley Gomez: scaling done, replicas now 12. seeing consumer lag drop in prometheus: pending_jobs from ~2100 -> ~900 in 45s.

Aisha Chen: temp traffic shift to us-east-1 in progress. patching router with route override: `service-router set-priority embeddings eu-west-1=0.7 us-east-1=0.3`

Samir K.: removed a handful of stuck items from the dead-letter queue (DLQ). command used:
```
aws sqs receive-message --queue-url https://sqs.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/12345/embeddings-dlq --max-number-of-messages 10
# inspected, then deleted problematic ones
```

Marta L.: customer-impact note: about ~3% of traffic got 429s during the spike window (approx 40m). most customers auto-retried; no data loss reported. creating a post-incident customer-impact blurb after we stabilize.

Aisha Chen: current status: mitigation actions applied, consumer lag falling, no new 500s. looking for steady-state for 10m before we close. last check:
- pending_jobs: 900 -> trending down
- 5xx rate: back to normal
- 429s: still trickling but decreasing

Jon Patel: created incident bridge -> https://callbridge.company/bridges/PD-94213 (join if you need context). also pinging CS to prep any customer pings if it stays >5m.

incident-bot: Reminder: Runbook: Embeddings queue backpressure -> https://runbook.company/embeddings-backpressure.md

Riley Gomez: flagging a follow-up action: HPA threshold needs tuning and we should add a warm standby in us-east for quick failover.

Samir K.: agree. also propose disabling suppression for this alert family for 15m in PD to avoid missed initial page. can someone with PD rights do that?

Marta L.: I'll open a short PD policy override now.

PagerDuty: Policy override applied by Marta L. for incident family emb-queue-backpressure for 15 minutes.

Aisha Chen: we hit steady-state threshold. moving to monitoring-only. I'm handing off to Jon for postmortem and customer comms.

Jon Patel: got it. ownership transfer: Aisha -> Jon. thanks for the quick work everyone. I'll post a summary and assign follow-up action items in the postmortem.

Marta L.: quick notes for postmortem: suppression policy review, HPA tuning, DLQ aging alerts, cross-region warm standby runbook.

incident-bot: Incident PD-94213 status changed to monitoring at 2991112285.

Jon Patel: closing the bridge in 10m if no regression. leaving this thread open for any late updates. :white_check_mark:
